title: 批量電郵活動後端 — Campaign 模型 + 範本 + 發送佇列 API
content:
建立批量電郵活動（Bulk Email Campaign）的後端基礎設施。

任務：
1. Campaign 資料模型 (Prisma)
   - EmailCampaign: id, name, subject, bodyHtml, bodyText, templateId?, status(DRAFT/SCHEDULED/SENDING/SENT/FAILED), recipientCount, sentCount, failedCount, scheduledAt, sentAt, createdById, createdAt, updatedAt
   - EmailCampaignRecipient: id, campaignId, registrantId, email, status(PENDING/SENT/FAILED/BOUNCED), errorMessage, sentAt

2. Campaign API Routes
   - POST /api/admin/email-campaigns — 建立活動（DRAFT 狀態）
   - GET /api/admin/email-campaigns — 列出所有活動
   - GET /api/admin/email-campaigns/[id] — 活動詳情
   - PATCH /api/admin/email-campaigns/[id] — 更新草稿
   - DELETE /api/admin/email-campaigns/[id] — 刪除草稿
   - POST /api/admin/email-campaigns/[id]/send — 發送（或排程）
   - POST /api/admin/email-campaigns/[id]/test — 發送測試郵件
   - GET /api/admin/email-campaigns/[id]/recipients — 收件者發送狀態

3. 收件者選取 API (GET /api/admin/registrants/for-campaign)
   - 查詢可成為收件者的 registrants
   - 參數：?courseId=, ?status=, ?paymentStatus=, ?dateRange=
   - 回傳：count + sample list

4. 範本系統（共用 AF-017 的郵件範本）
   - 管理員可選擇既有範本作為基礎 → 編輯主題/內容
   - 或者從空白建立
   - 變數插入：{{registrantName}}, {{courseName}}, {{enrolmentDate}} 等

5. 發送引擎
   - 非同步發送：background job
   - 使用 SES 批次發送（注意 rate limit）
   - 逐筆更新 EmailCampaignRecipient 狀態
   - 進度回報

⚠️ 高風險 — 大量郵件發送可能觸發 SES rate limit 或 spam 投訴。需實作 rate limiting + 退信處理。
⚠️ 依賴 AF-016（SES 正式化）、AF-017（郵件範本）。
acceptance: Prisma migration creates EmailCampaign + EmailCampaignRecipient tables
Full CRUD API for email campaigns works
Send API submits all recipients to send queue and returns campaign ID
Recipient selection API returns filtered registrants with count
Campaign with DRAFT status can be edited, SENDING cannot
Test email sends to admin's own email for preview
Rate limiting prevents SES quota exceedance
npm run typecheck && npm run lint pass
files: src/lib/email/campaign.ts (new — campaign send engine with rate limiting)
verification: Create campaign via API → add recipients → send test → send live → recipient status tracks correctly.
